title: Municipal  Model High School
description: Municipal Model School, Vijayawada—an honest expression of exposed brick, concrete, and glass in a contemporary civic form.
notes: Municipal Model School, Vijayawada, is designed as a bold yet grounded institutional structure that embraces raw materials as its architectural language. The exposed brick façade and concrete elements create a sense of permanence and honesty, while expansive glass panels bring in light and transparency. The signature arched entrance forms a striking focal point, combining structural clarity with civic identity. The rustic material palette and minimal detailing reflect both functionality and contemporary design sensibility.
